_readme: The founder's blog. Posts render in the order listed here — newest first. Body is an array of blocks so no Markdown parser ships to the browser: use type 'p' for a paragraph, 'h2' for a subheading, and 'quote' for a pulled-out line. Marathi and English can be mixed freely; both fonts carry Devanagari.

author._name_todo: The founder's name, as it should be credited on every post.
author._photo_todo: A portrait. Or drop a file named author-1.jpg into src/assets/photos and it is picked up automatically.
author._bio_todo: Two or three lines — who they are and why they started Folklok.

_post_shape.title: English title
_post_shape.excerpt: One or two lines shown on the listing page.
_post_shape.photo: optional — a filename prefix from src/assets/photos, e.g. 'live-07'
